comment: The “full-STAC” approach provides a memorable framing, but the four open dimensions do not cover all enabling conditions described elsewhere, such as governance, financing, workforce capacity, cybersecurity, legal authority, service management, and institutional ownership.

public.text: The “full-STAC” approach provides a memorable framing, but the four open dimensions do not cover all enabling conditions described elsewhere, such as governance, financing, workforce capacity, cybersecurity, legal authority, service management, and institutional ownership.
public.suggestedRevision: Present full-STAC as a technical and content foundation within a broader set of REDDHI enabling conditions, rather than as the complete set of enabling conditions.
